text:
Mina: Heads-up: planning a small change to the metering ingest tomorrow — we'll replace `route_tag_v2` with a compact `routing_id` to trim event size. This might shift attribution for a tiny percentage of sessions. :eyes:

Kai: Is this the rename we sketched last week? How will consumers handle both fields?

Mina: We'll ship dual-write behind a feature flag `metering.proto.v2_enabled` for 48h. Consumers will read `routing_id` if present, fall back to `route_tag_v2`. After canary and validation we remove the legacy field from mapper output.

Oliver: UI impact: invoice preview joins on legacy tag today. If mapper flips early we'll show preview deltas until preview windows close. Need a visible indicator in the preview to show which key was used.

Ashley: Agreed. Also propose a reconciliation metric that compares the two fields so we can detect divergence early. Threshold alert at 0.5% mismatch during canary.

Dex: I'll add `billing.routing_mismatch.count` with tags {env, canary_pct} and a rate metric `billing.routing_mismatch.rate`. Also add a top-ten tenants breakdown when mismatch > 0.1%.

Mina: Nice. SQL for quick verification if you want to run manual checks: ```sql
SELECT routing_id, route_tag_v2 AS legacy_tag, count(*) cnt
FROM metering.events
WHERE ts >= :start AND ts < :end
GROUP BY routing_id, legacy_tag
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

Kai: Rollback plan? Auto rollback risky given small attribution noise. Prefer manual rollback + pause. Documented steps?

Oliver: Manual only. We'll create a hotfix path and a pause for the canary gate. If mismatch spike > 0.5%, ops pauses rollout, we investigate.

Mina: Proposed rollout: 5% canary (2h monitor), 25% (6h), 100% (after checks). During canary, attach the invoice-preview cohort so finance/CS can validate.

Ashley: Filing a console UX ticket to add the routing source badge in invoice preview header (legacy | routing_id). Will include an example mismatch indicator. Ticket -> PROD-6132.

Dex: I'll also expose a trace link with sample tenant ids where mismatch occurred so SRE/product can triage.

billing-bot: Deploy scheduled: metering-enrichment v3 -> canary @ 2026-03-22T02:00Z. Monitors: billing.routing_mismatch.count, invoice_preview.delta_pct, ingest.latency.p50.

Mina: One more: maintain a short-lived fallback mapping in Redis (TTL 7d) keyed by event_id to handle late arrivals. Consumers should prefer `routing_id`, then consult mapping, then fallback to `route_tag_v2`.

Kai: No schema migration needed then, good. Make sure the mapping TTL is long enough for invoice preview windows.

Oliver: Add dashboard panels: 7d rolling `preview_diff_rate`, `invoice_estimated_delta_pct`, and `routing_mismatch_top_tenants`. Finance wants per-tenant drilldowns.

Dex: Will add those panels and the drilldowns. Also add an alert that pins the offending tenant ids when mismatch > 0.5% for 10m.

Mina: Action items: Mina -> run the FF rollout plan; Dex -> metrics + traces + dashboard; Ashley -> console UX ticket; Kai -> update rollback runbook; Oliver -> coordinate finance/CS validation. Reconvene after 25% canary or if alert fires.

Kai: Ping me if mismatch > 0.5% during the 5% canary.

Ashley: Notified finance and CS leads in billing channel.

Mina: Deploy started. billing-bot: Canary 5% live -> metering-enrichment v3 @ 2026-03-22T02:05Z (canary_id: c-8342).

Dex: Metrics flowing. Watching `billing.routing_mismatch.rate` now.

Oliver: 4cc watching dashboards.

Mina: No changes to token counting/quantization layers. This is metadata-only.

Kai: Great. I'll update the runbook and stand by for rollback steps.

Mina: Will close this thread after 100% sweep or rollback. Thanks everyone. :shipit:
